games.desc:
Ragdoll Testing is a realistic ragdoll physics simulator.

Q - MENU (Gamepasses, Settings, Avatar, Teleports, Radio etc.)
R - Ragdoll, E - Antigravity, L - Reset, C - FP Camera, F - Emotes

Get a FREE Private Server to play with friends!
Private servers have free titan and let you scale up to 45!

Don't see some tools on mobile? Tap 3 dots in right top and then tap on inventory in drop down menu.

RT is a size difference game, if you cannot hit someone even with PVP enabled, they're likely too big for you to hit. If someone can't be damaged, they turned off damage in settings. Remember you cannot hit pvp off and safezone players!

games.desc:

This game supports Consoles and mobile devices.
Controls:
Stance - 1 / Dpad Up 
Lock On/Shift Lock - Shift / Dpad Down 
Taunt - G / Dpad Left 
Menu - M / Dpad Right 
Light Attack - M1 / X / Square 
Heavy Attack/Finisher - M2 / Y / Triangle

Block - F / LB / L1 
Skill 1 - Q / RB / R1 
Skill 2 - E / B / Circle 
Heat Action - R / RT / R2
